identity.name: Seeds Honeycomb — Idea Incubator
identity.description: Seeds are raw ideas, unprocessed concepts, and Scout Agent findings. They are stored as individual JSON files in honeycombs/seeds/. New seeds are collected into inbox/ for review, then promoted to root or deleted.

structure.description: Seeds are stored directly in honeycombs/seeds/ as JSON files. No subfolders except inbox/ for new seeds.

lifecycle.inbox: New seeds from Scout Agent go to honeycombs/seeds/inbox/

rules.duplicate_check: Scout Agent checks url against all seeds in inbox/ and seeds/ before saving
rules.manual_review: All seeds must be reviewed by Gardener before promotion
rules.no_archive: Seeds are either active (in root) or deleted. No archive subfolder.

health.notes: v3.1.0: simplified index, moved seed inventory to individual files, added inbox/ workflow
